section_summary.extract_value: This section discusses the results of Studies 1 and 2, indicating that participants with higher overall creative achievement had lower LI scores. The main focus shifts to identifying and analyzing 'eminent creative achievers' by pooling participants from both studies. Criteria for eminent achievement are defined as at least 12 points on the CAQ in any of 10 individual domains, achieved before age 21, to allow for analysis of LI and IQ.
section_summary.evidence_source: ANALYSIS OF EMINENT CREATIVE ACHIEVERS The results of Studies 1 and 2 indicate that participants who scored higher in overall creative achievement exhibited significantly lower LI scores than participants who did not score high in creative achievement. By pooling the participants from both studies, we hoped to identify enough eminent creative achievers (those who made a truly substantive contribution to a single domain of creative endeavor before the age of 21) to allow for analysis of LI and IQ. We defined a score of at least 12 points on the CAQ in any one of the 10 individual domains of measured creative achievement as constituting a clearly significant contribution to a creative field.
